# Getting Into Drone Construction

## Core Knowledge Areas

### Electronics & Electrical
- Basic circuit theory (voltage, current, resistance)
- Soldering skills
- Battery technology (LiPo batteries are common)
- Electronic Speed Controllers (ESCs)
- Power distribution

### Mechanics & Physics
- Aerodynamics basics
- Frame design and materials
- Motor selection and thrust calculations
- Propeller physics
- Weight and balance

### Programming & Software
- Flight controller firmware (Betaflight, ArduPilot, PX4)
- Basic coding (Python or C++ helpful)
- Mission planning software
- PID tuning

---

## Practical Skills

- **3D printing** - for custom frames/parts
- **CAD software** - designing components
- **Reading schematics** - wiring diagrams
- **Troubleshooting** - diagnosing failures

---

## Good Starting Points

- Build a basic FPV racing drone kit first
- Join communities like **RCGroups** or **Reddit r/Multicopter**
- Watch YouTube channels (Joshua Bardwell is popular)
- Take online courses on electronics basics

---

## Regulations to Know
- FAA Part 107 (if in the US)
- Registration requirements
- Airspace rules

Would you like more detail on any specific area?
